title: Ramsey number R(4,21), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_4 and no blue K_21; it shows R(4,21) > n. The best known lower bound is R(4,21) >= 257, so a colouring of K_256 is known and one of K_257 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(4,21) >= 257: implied by the recursion e: R(4,20) + 5; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 242; read 5 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
provenance.revision: revision 18 (24 Apr 2026) and later sources named
provenance.holder: implied by the recursion e: R(4,20) + 5

score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(4,21) >= n + 1 (larger is better)
